nav_selector: #content-nav (probe harness element serializing queryCollectionNavigation("content") into the generated /navtree page; the official content starter template renders NO navigation element of its own)
actual_rule_observed: A new page with no navigation key appears in the navigation tree, ordered by stem (filename-derived, extension stripped) ascending: about < banana < index.
notes: Starter renders no navigation natively (app.vue only renders NuxtPage; [...slug].vue renders a single page via ContentRenderer), so the navigation TREE was probed via a temporary harness page app/pages/navtree.vue that server-renders queryCollectionNavigation("content") into <nav id="content-nav">. matched_documented_rule is false because the official docs page could not be loaded in this environment (see rule.json/searches.json); placement is consistent with the v3 runtime default of stem ASC.
